calibration.reason: Clear labels and legibility support the task, but the familiar layout limits originality and misplaced focus after invalid input materially hurts recovery.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its name, blue backlight and effect on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed and retained visible focus. The title and description changed to Flood and Blue backlight; blue light outlined the figure and a shadow extended forward.

A-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static, retained a visible focus outline, and changed the label and lighting. The immediate capture caught a transition with residual blue; the settled mobile view showed the white side light clearly.
A-1440.fact_check: Flood and Static descriptions were present. The Static accessible description claims a right-side beam and leftward shadow; the settled mobile rendering supports this, while the immediate desktop capture was transitional.
A-1440.strength: The wide stage, restrained dark surround and large cue name make the lighting effect the focal point.
A-1440.weakness: The figure is generic and the stage illustration feels more diagrammatic than expressive.
A-1440.repair: Give the performer and stage more theatrical character while preserving the clear light and shadow geometry.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its name, blue backlight and effect on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed with visible focus. The settled view showed a blue beam behind the outlined figure and a long foreground shadow, with Flood and Blue backlight below.

A-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static. The stage changed to a white beam from the right, with a leftward shadow; focus remained visibly on Static.
A-390.fact_check: The visible cue names and descriptions match the requested states. The first after capture was taken during the color transition; A-390-after-settled shows the completed state.
A-390.strength: The stage, cue information and controls all fit in the initial viewport without horizontal overflow.
A-390.weakness: The narrow crop removes some stage context, and the centered standing figure is visually plain.
A-390.repair: Add distinctive performer detail without reducing the readable mobile light pattern.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its name, blue backlight and effect on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed and retained visible focus. The panel showed Flood and Blue backlight; the performer was outlined in blue with a shadow across the foreground.

B-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static, with a visible focus outline. The stage changed to a hard white beam from the left of the image and a shadow to the right.
B-1440.fact_check: The visible names and descriptions match the requested states. The accessible description calls the beam stage left; the image shows it entering from the viewer's left, so the theatrical direction claim is not independently established.
B-1440.strength: The expressive performer and light-colored control panel form a distinctive, coherent theatrical composition.
B-1440.weakness: The active cue relies on a relatively subtle colored underline and text change when focus is elsewhere.
B-1440.repair: Strengthen the selected state with an additional persistent shape or fill while retaining the separate focus outline.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its name, blue backlight and effect on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed with visible focus. Its name and Blue backlight appeared below a blue-lit performer and foreground shadow.

B-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static. A white side beam and rightward shadow replaced the blue scene, and focus remained visibly on Static.
B-390.fact_check: The cue names, descriptions and visible lighting changes were verified. The accessible stage-left direction is not independently established from the illustration alone.
B-390.strength: The stacked composition preserves the expressive stage and keeps all three controls visible in the initial viewport.
B-390.weakness: The selected underline is less conspicuous than the focus outline, making persistent selection easier to miss.
B-390.repair: Give the selected cue a stronger persistent visual treatment distinct from keyboard focus.

preference.reason: Both views completed the keyboard task with visible focus and clear lighting changes. B's expressive performer and composed stage make the lighting demonstration more distinctive while keeping the controls and descriptions legible at both widths.

decision: Round 4 improves the weaker mobile score to 8.65 and becomes the strongest verified lighting candidate. The persistent selected cue was too subtle away from focus. Round 5 introduces a filled, labeled selected state.
